caveat: Dated 2025 and Consensus gives no month, so the 12-month window could not be verified. A practice paper: Cynefin is applied, not tested.
title: Leadership by Learning Design: embrace complexity where it exists
venue: Journal of Learning Development in Higher Education
why: Applies the Cynefin framework to learning design for climate action and decolonisation, and names constructive alignment itself as complicit in reducing complex problems to tidy predetermined outcomes.
